title: Wizarding World
subtitle: Magic Awaits
description: The complete Wizarding World saga in chronological order.

movies.title: Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
movies.synopsis: Magizoologist Newt Scamander arrives in 1920s New York, where escaped magical creatures threaten to expose the wizarding world.

movies.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
movies.synopsis: Newt joins a young Albus Dumbledore's effort to stop the dark wizard Gellert Grindelwald from dividing the magical and non-magical worlds.

movies.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
movies.synopsis: Dumbledore entrusts Newt and his allies with a dangerous mission to challenge Grindelwald's growing power.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
movies.synopsis: An orphaned boy discovers he is a wizard and begins his first year at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
movies.synopsis: Harry returns to Hogwarts as a hidden chamber is opened and a mysterious force begins attacking students.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
movies.synopsis: Harry learns that an escaped prisoner may be connected to his family's past while dark forces close in on Hogwarts.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
movies.synopsis: Harry is unexpectedly chosen to compete in a dangerous international magical tournament as Voldemort's return draws near.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
movies.synopsis: Harry forms a secret student group to resist the Ministry's denial of Voldemort's return.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
movies.synopsis: Dumbledore prepares Harry for the coming war by uncovering the secrets behind Voldemort's immortality.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
movies.synopsis: Harry, Ron, and Hermione leave Hogwarts to hunt the Horcruxes that hold the key to defeating Voldemort.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
movies.synopsis: Harry returns to Hogwarts for the final battle against Voldemort and the forces of darkness.
